scripts.build: pnpm verify:version && pnpm --filter oldman-web build && pnpm --filter oldman-admin build
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check oldman tests scripts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter oldman-web test && pnpm --filter oldman-admin test && uv run --index-strategy unsafe-best-match python3 -m unittest discover tests
scripts.typecheck: uv run pyright && pnpm --filter oldman-web typecheck && pnpm --filter oldman-admin typecheck
scripts.build:python: pnpm verify:version && pnpm --filter oldman-admin build && SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1580601600 uv build --package oldman
scripts.verify: pnpm verify:static && pnpm verify:python && pnpm verify:frontend && pnpm verify:web-boundaries && pnpm verify:packages && pnpm verify:scaffold-matrix
scripts.verify:python: uv run --index-strategy unsafe-best-match python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
scripts.verify:frontend: pnpm --filter oldman-web test && pnpm --filter oldman-web typecheck && pnpm --filter oldman-admin test && pnpm --filter oldman-admin typecheck
